assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a completely NEW Mastered mastery badge from scratch for Kikimashta, using the supplied Strong and Confident badges only as style and layout references. Do NOT reproduce an older Mastered design. Match their same square canvas, chunky deep-purple contours, warm cream center, soft illustrated shading and yellow/pink/lavender palette.

CRITICAL SHARED LAYOUT: the circular cream medallion must have the SAME SIZE and POSITION as the supplied Confident badge: x about24%..74%, y about20%..61% above the ribbon. Cream circle approximately50% canvas diameter, centered x49% y45%. The front lavender ribbon must be in the EXACT SAME POSITION and have the SAME SIZE as the reference Confident ribbon: front panel upper arch y60% at center, y67% near outer corners; lower arch y84% at center and y90% near corners; front panel x12%..88%. Side folded tails and curl folds around y75%..98%. Do not put the ribbon lower. No extra space above the ribbon. Keep this common medallion/ribbon layout unchanged while decorating around it.

MASTERED DESIGN: a golden scalloped outer medal rim instead of Confident's pink/laurel frame; a SMALL lavender-and-pink crown centered just above the medallion (roughly x38%..61%, y1%..18%), and compact lavender wings extending sideways beside the medal (roughly x7%..23% and x76%..93%, y32%..60%). Crown and wings should distinguish Mastered without enlarging or moving the center or ribbon. Graceful rounded crown with pink tips and a small pink flower emblem. Keep outer silhouette within x2%..98%, y1%..99%.

Inside the cream face place the SAME little pink sakura flower and two detached side petals from the references, centered around x49% y28%, spanning about29% canvas width and13% height. Leave the face BELOW it empty for interchangeable WK text. The ribbon front must be completely empty for interchangeable picture/pencil and level overlays. No WK letters, suitcase, level text, picture icon or pencil. One finished polished transparent badge base only. True alpha outside complete silhouette, preserve all opaque pale cream details; no backdrop, checkerboard, glow or extra objects.
assets.preparation: cwebp -lossless -resize 384 0; preserve aspect and originals preserved
assets.status: fresh Mastered design using Strong/Confident layout; awaiting owner feedback
